_comment: Update pointer for the 'Update Library' flow. A device fetches this file, compares latest.libraryVersion to its installed catalog, and (if newer) downloads latest.url (the catalog manifest), then fetches each board listed in manifest.boards in order, validates them, and loads them via loadLibrary(boards, { libraryVersion }).

latest.notes: Minor: DroidNet fork boards. Adds two device-native boards, each listed right after its stock board. RSeriesLogic · DroidNet fork (droidnet-rseries-logic) has Brightness (rseries.cfg.brightness): #LEBRI{unit}{level}, where the unit is none (both displays), F (front) or R (rear) and the level is 1-255. FlthyHPs · DroidNet fork (droidnet-flthy-hps) has Brightness (flthy.led.brightness): H{unit}B{level}, where the unit is F, R, T, X, Y, Z or A (all) and the level is 1-255. Both need the DroidNet fork firmware named in the board's firmware field; stock RSeriesLogic and FlthyHPs firmware ignore them. The level is RAM-only: nothing is saved on the board, and a power cycle restores the power-on brightness. The stock boards are unchanged. Board catalog 22 -> 24, commands 500 -> 502. Safety: new class `storedcommand` for commands that run a command the user saved on the WCB (;C/;SEQ run-sequence, and the DFPlayer/MP3 play+ONFIN callbacks, which were cosmetic). Queries, save and clear stay config.
